Cube Storage Pioneers

Little Robots, Big Business

Since its inception in 1996, AutoStore™ has worked to improve warehouse efficiency. Today, the company’s key value proposition is to deliver an easy-to-use software powered cubic automatic storage and retrieval ecosystem.

The AutoStore solution is modular and flexible, and can automate any warehouse. The system offers a superior customer value proposition across operating metrics, ESG scores, and customer economics.
‍

elements.title: Yoon Do-young (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Yoon Do-young (pictured) scored his debut goal for Daejeon Hana Citizen 50 seconds into a match against Gwangju FC?

elements.title: 2007 Greensburg tornado (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the 2007 Greensburg tornado had ten smaller tornadoes orbiting it?

elements.title: Dostrotime (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that a music video for a song on the album Dostrotime was made with an oscilloscope?

elements.title: Ethanoligenens harbinense (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the bacterium Ethanoligenens harbinense can produce hydrogen?

elements.title: Bob Hainlen (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Bob Hainlen, at the age of 22, was both a player and an assistant coach for a professional American football team?

elements.title: Izvestiya Askhabadskogo Soveta (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Izvestiya Askhabadskogo Soveta was the first Bolshevik newspaper published in present-day Turkmenistan?

elements.title: James Michael Reardon (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that after he did not come home for dinner, James Michael Reardon's assistant priests found that he had died in his basilica while praying?

elements.title: Sams Creek (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the area around Sams Creek was excluded from Kahurangi National Park when it was formed in 1996 due to gold-mining interests?

elements.title: Susan Finnegan (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Susan Finnegan was the first female head of the arachnids section at the Natural History Museum, London, but had to resign her job to marry?
